_doc: Tuning for the playing surface (GDD 2, GDD 10): blue artificial grass with sand infill, inlaid white lines and play wear. Read by asset_lib/turf_textures.py (textures) and blender/build_court_surface.py (mesh). Lengths in metres unless the key says mm. Court positions use the half-court frame: d = distance from the net toward that team's back glass, y across the court. Every zone is mirrored to both halves, and to both sides when mirror_y is true. Colours and material strengths are in palette.json (court.Turf).

fibre._doc: One tile of T_Turf_N / T_Turf_Masks. Tufted monofilament: rows every gauge_mm, a tuft every stitch_mm along the row, blades fanning out from each tuft and leaning a little. The tile holds a whole number of rows and stitches so it repeats without a seam.

court_masks._doc: T_CourtSurface_Masks covers the 20 x 10 playing area (UV1). R = wear (flattened fibres), G = loose sand (drift), B = turf roll tint. Linear values 0..1.

wear_zones._doc: back defence, where players spend most of a rally
serve and return spot behind the service line
the T where the centre line meets the service line
back corners, retrieving off the glass
transition lane between the back and the net

scuffs._doc: Short streaks from planted feet and slides, scattered inside the wear zones. Mostly across the court (players move sideways).

mesh._doc: SM_CourtSurface geometry. The turf is a grid so Nanite and Lumen see a little real unevenness; the ball still bounces on the flat Z = 0 of CourtSpec.h.
